title: Software breakpoints
hints: Keep a `std::map` from address to saved original byte. `view()` is a copy of the code with those saved bytes written back over it.

Between `onBreakpoint` and `onSingleStep` the original byte is in the code so the real instruction can run; remember which breakpoint to put back in an `std::optional`. If it was removed in the meantime, do not re-arm it.
